# ELECTRO storefront adaptation
Source: https://github.com/uiuxlabz/electronics-store-html-template
Revision: fe95791e3dd74fd13e95e7045420a2358c44328e
Author: uiuxlabz. README declares MIT, “use commercially, modify freely”.
Adapted assets/css/styles.css product-card and products-grid rules and index.html card structure. Scoped to .aod; colors, mobile grid, copy and behavior customized. Checkout, catalog, orders and story linking belong to BBBTAI. No claim that the full upstream application runs unchanged.

Images: generated generic product illustrations for this project; not manufacturer photography. Catalog details follow the user's IMG_4621(1).jpeg. Retail prices are authored story prices in USD, not real procurement quotes. Windows Server is counted once; CUDA/TensorFlow/PyTorch installation is included as a service. No unspecified exact motherboard model is invented.
